$comment: Documented, EXPIRING exceptions for `npm run audit:ci` (the CI supply-chain gate, tasks.md 6.3/6.4). Every entry needs a reason, an advisory URL, and an `expires` date; once expired it no longer suppresses the advisory, so the gate re-blocks and forces a fresh review. Any high/critical advisory NOT listed here still blocks. Keep this list short and each entry justified.

allow.reason: DoS via unbounded brace expansion (OOM). Reached only through BUILD TOOLING glob matching (eslint -> minimatch@3 -> brace-expansion@1.x); it is absent from the production dependency tree (`npm audit --omit=dev` does not report it), and no runtime code path passes an attacker-controlled glob to minimatch, so the vulnerable expansion is unreachable in the running app. The 5.x path was genuinely fixed (5.0.7 -> 5.0.8 via `npm audit fix`); no patched 1.x exists (1.1.16 is the latest), so the remaining path can only be cleared by an eslint 10 major upgrade, tracked as its own slice.
